title: Interfaces of the specified chosen-duality Weil exchange
statement: For the existing bounded constructible common-stage categories and Frobenius fixed-pair categories, retain the specified three-transpose component, chosen-adjoint comparison, Exchange structure, model point and structure map, carrier and pair categories, permitted Hom pair, ordinary and exceptional lifted adjunctions, HomLift with carrier object/map/evaluation normalization, tensor-unit-normalized Constant and its pair, geometric compactification, Data of Hom lifts and composition/projection isomorphisms with their carrier normalizations, OrdinaryMaps, and Data.Laws. These are the existing definitions moved unchanged to an interface module, not existence or naturality theorems.

lean.statement: def transposeComponent {X : Type a} {Y : Type b} [Category.{va} X] [Category.{vb} Y] {F : X ⥤ Y} {G : Y ⥤ X} {P : Y ⥤ X} {Q : X ⥤ Y} (exceptional : F ⊣ G) (ordinary : P ⊣ Q) (TX : X ⥤ X ⥤ X) (TY : Y ⥤ Y ⥤ Y) (HX : Xᵒᵖ × X ⥤ X) (HY : Yᵒᵖ × Y ⥤ Y) (closedX : ∀ M, TX.obj M ⊣ (Functor.curry.obj HX).obj (op M)) (closedY : ∀ N, TY.obj N ⊣ (Functor.curry.obj HY).obj (op N)) (projection : ∀ M A, (TY.obj (F.obj M)).obj A ≅ F.obj ((TX.obj M).obj (P.obj A))) (omega : Y) (M : X) : HY.obj (op (F.obj M), omega) ⟶ Q.obj (HX.obj (op M, G.obj omega))
